_about: What soldiers say under interrogation; the core picks one line at random from the list that fits. `opener` comes before a line of intel (from missions.json); `nothing` is a soldier who will not or cannot talk; `marks` is one who knows nothing himself but points out soldiers near him; `alone` is one with nobody near to give up; `again` is one already asked. Several are about Big Chum, whom every soldier on the island has heard of.
opener: "Big Chum? Here? Alright, I'll tell you."
"Varga will have my head... but sure."
"Ask me anything, I hate this place."
"I knew you'd come one day. Here's what I know."
nothing: "I just guard the fence! Nobody tells me anything!"
"I've been here two days. I don't even know where the mess hall is."
"I swear on my mother, I don't know."
"They don't tell grunts like me anything."
"Big Chum... is it really you? I wish I knew something. I really do."
"I was asleep at the briefing. Honestly."
"Please, I only work the radio. It's all static."
marks: "There's... there's more of us. Over there."
"I'm not the only one out here. Look, there, and there."
"My squad's close. That's all I've got."
"The others are on rounds nearby. Don't hurt them, they're alright."
"Over by the crates, and one up top. That's everyone I know of."
alone: "I'm on my own out here, I swear."
"Nobody else on this stretch. They put me here because nobody likes me."
"No one's close. You could have walked right past."
